Simulated TC is 117 ppm/C, and +10% in K raises it by 118%. The reference is too PTAT, which fits Vref being high at 1.275 V. A linear estimate puts the PTAT/CTAT balance near K ≈ 9.5, where Vref would be about 1.22 V, still inside 1.1–1.3 V. The topology, start-up circuit, line regulation and power all pass, so I'll refine K numerically rather than edit the program.
